name: complete-guide-ld-pack
description: The Complete Claude Guide for L&D: 40 Claude skills for the whole L&D job, in eight stages: diagnose the need with the request triage, the performance gap and the action map; work with the experts through the interview, the task breakdown and the review plan; design the learning with objectives, an evaluation plan, a design document and a curriculum map; build and test scenarios, a storyboard, a knowledge check, the check of an AI draft and a learner walkthrough; run the room with a session plan, slides, a facilitator guide and a pilot; carry it into work with a job aid, spaced practice and a manager briefing; measure what changed with a feedback form, an ROI estimate and the one-page report; and lead L&D through the year plan and the business case. For L&D managers and specialists, instructional designers, trainers and facilitators, and L&D leaders. Claude drafts and checks, people decide: nothing a learner does in training is used to grade, rank or build a case against them.
